title: React.js Development - Part 1
description: React.js development with Vite, covering components, state management, hooks, routing, API integration, Redux Toolkit, React Query, and performance optimization. This submodule covers: React fundamentals, Vite, Components, JSX, Props, State, Events, Conditional rendering, Lists.

Manage state with useState, useEffect, and context
Implement client-side routing with React Router
